units.source_text: 渔业联合组织的办公室里像在开会，四五个男人，围坐成一圈，正在大声说笑。

en.t: Inside the office of the fisheries cooperative, it looked as though a meeting was going on; four or five men were sitting in a circle, laughing and talking loudly.

units.source_text: 大门正面挂着个大横匾，上书“爱乡精神”。

en.t: A large horizontal signboard hung over the front of the main gate, inscribed with the words “Love of Hometown Spirit.”

units.source_text: 不知老头说了一句什么话，说笑声戛然而止。

en.t: Whatever the old man said, the laughter and chatter stopped abruptly.

units.source_text: 像有人在催促他似的，老头站起来就往外走。

en.t: As if someone were urging him on, the old man stood up and immediately headed outside.

units.source_text: 贝壳铺的道路，在幽暗中泛起了朦胧的白光。

en.t: The road paved with shells gave off a faint, hazy white glow in the dimness.
